summary: Phase 1A end-to-end validation PASSED. All 17 backend pytest tests green (health, auth/me, profile, memory CRUD, chat happy-path with real Claude Sonnet 4.6, 403 when signup gate not complete, 401 when no token, 429 daily_cap_reached, memory auto-summary after 6th exchange via Haiku 4.5, founding20 apply + duplicate 400, feedback up + invalid rating 422). Frontend E2E validated via Playwright cookie injection (session_token httpOnly secure sameSite=None on the preview domain worked first try): unauth onboarding->welcome->FourBurners carousel->back; authed SignupGate (age+consent+documentary_interest) -> Home; Home shows all 6 data-testids; MemoryScreen view/edit/save/reset/back; TrackScreen 4 options -> ChatScreen with opening message, live Claude reply ('Hey — welcome. What's actually going on?') rendered, back to Home; Founding20 3-question form submits, shows 'You're in the pool' applied state, DB row persists.
critical_code_review_comments: config.py sets SUMMARY_MAX_TOKENS=300 but build_memory_card() never passes it to the Haiku call via .with_params(max_tokens=...) — currently that cap is dead code. Works fine because the system prompt says 'Max 5 short lines', but wire the cap through for safety/cost.

chat() updates current_track from the request unconditionally ({'current_track': track or user.current_track}) — if a user sends a chat with no track param and no prior track, this writes an empty string. Consider only setting when truthy.
founding20/apply returns {'ok': True} only — frontend relies on state transition. Consider returning the inserted application so the UI doesn't need a second /status call.

Auth: session expiration comparison already handles tz-naive vs tz-aware — good. But user_sessions has no TTL index on expires_at; expired rows accumulate forever. Add a TTL index: db.user_sessions.create_index('expires_at', expireAfterSeconds=0).
server.py is 487 lines with routers, models, prompts, LLM calls all in one file. Not blocking, but as Phase 2 grows consider splitting into routers/, models/, services/ modules.

CORS is allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject this combo. It works today because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL == frontend origin (same-origin via ingress), so no CORS preflight fires. If you ever split domains, this will break silently. Set CORS_ORIGINS explicitly to the preview/prod URL.
test_credentials: No real Google account used. Seeded test users directly in MongoDB max_coach.users + max_coach.user_sessions per /app/auth_testing.md. Cookie attrs that worked for the preview domain: name=session_token, domain=app-builder-4470.preview.emergentagent.com, path=/, httpOnly=True, secure=True, sameSite=None. All TEST_* data cleaned up at end of run.
seed_data_creation: Each backend test creates an ephemeral TEST_user_* + TEST_sess_* and tears it down via fixture. Memory auto-summary test seeds 5 prior chat_logs with exchange_count_since_summary=5 and fires 1 real /api/chat to trigger the 6-threshold summarizer (avoids 6 real LLM calls). Daily-cap test seeds daily_count=30 with today's ISO date to avoid 30 real calls. All TEST_ prefixed data is purged in session teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_max_coach_api.py — run with: MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=max_coach REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<preview-url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_max_coach_api.py -v. Takes ~12s total; includes two real Claude calls (happy-path + auto-summary) so needs EMERGENT_LLM_KEY set. For Playwright auth, cookie injection pattern proven: put session_token cookie on the preview domain with sameSite='None', secure=True, httpOnly=True, path='/'. Same-origin ingress means frontend fetch with credentials:'include' will send it automatically. All data-testids in the problem statement exist and render correctly.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Main agent's concern about cookie injection 401 was resolved: the cookie attributes from auth_testing.md (httpOnly, secure, sameSite='None', path='/') worked on the first attempt once the exact preview domain was used.
